name: com.pg.building
description: Build mode from World without Time: place things from blueprints or from the bag with a ghost, rotate, dismantle, materials taken from the inventory, build catalog, blueprint pickups and unlocks, build screen and no-build zones. Requires com.pg.inventory-system, com.pg.menu, com.pg.localization-system, com.pg.save-system, com.pg.interact-system. Magic, flight, telekinesis, dialogue, input contexts and achievements are connected through BuildBridge.
author: Lucia Lunadottir
